fact: The 2022 yearbook states that facility monthly reports, of health centres as of other facilities, are sent on paper and electronically to the districts and entered in the national DHIS2 platform, with a national data review held in 2022.
title: Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2022
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique, Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement
